spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present simple for a regular routine?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] My brother cycles to work every morning. He says it keeps him fit.
B. [WRONG] My brother is cycling to work this week because his car is in the garage.
C. [WRONG] My brother cycled to work every day when he lived in the city centre.
D. [WRONG] My brother is cycling in the park at the moment.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: My brother is cycling to work this week because his car is in the garage., My brother cycled to work every day when he lived in the city centre., My brother is cycling in the park at the moment.
